conditions: Cite the Board as the source.
Do not reuse Board seals or logos.
Exclude any item specifically marked as non-Board or separately copyrighted.
federal_reserve_board.finding: Board website information is public domain unless otherwise indicated, and DDP documentation expressly supports direct automated retrieval.

conditions: Display the BEA API non-endorsement notice where the API is identified.
Cite the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
Do not modify BEA content and continue to represent the modification as BEA content.
bea.finding: The API permits services that retrieve, display, and analyze BEA data; published BEA information is public domain unless stated otherwise.

conditions: Display the Census Data API non-endorsement notice where the API is identified.
Cite Census only as the source of original data; label DFRI estimates as DFRI's responsibility.
Do not modify API content and continue to represent the modification as Census content.
census.finding: The API permits services that retrieve, display, and analyze published Census data, and the public-use statement explicitly anticipates independently produced estimates.

conditions: Use the exact attribution: New York Fed Consumer Credit Panel / Equifax.
Clearly label modifications and do not attribute DFRI derivatives to the New York Fed.
Do not impose more restrictive terms on redistributed New York Fed Content.
Do not republish raw New York Fed workbooks in DFRI feeds; publish separately labeled DFRI-derived aggregates only.
new_york_fed.finding: The terms expressly permit automated access, downloading, storage, copying, distribution, modification, and derivative works, subject to attribution and distribution conditions.

conditions: Use a descriptive User-Agent with contact information.
Limit aggregate traffic to no more than 10 requests per second.
Cite the SEC and do not imply affiliation or reuse SEC seals/logos.
sec_edgar.finding: SEC developer resources permit classified automated EDGAR access under fair-access limits; sec.gov information may be copied or further distributed with citation.

conditions: Use a meaningful User-Agent and follow API pacing, caching, maxlag, and retry guidance.
Attribute the Wikipedia source page and preserve its revision identifier.
Keep the membership snapshot itself under CC BY-SA 4.0 and do not impose more restrictive terms on that snapshot.
wikimedia.finding: Wikimedia permits automated API access under its access policy and permits commercial reuse and redistribution of Wikipedia text under CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution and share-alike conditions.
